evaluation_protocol.primary: Concept-macro full correctness on independent_use acquisition tasks; exclude composition
evaluation_protocol.unknown_policy: Include unknown and capped cases in denominators; unknown is not a mathematical error
evaluation_protocol.threshold_interpretation: Exploratory decision threshold, not a powered significance claim
evaluation_protocol.retention_rule: Require at least one correct inverse independent-use validation item before the interlude. After the same frozen unrelated interlude, inverse successes must not decrease. Report item transitions. A zero baseline is unassessable, not retained knowledge.
evaluation_protocol.selection: Among retention-eligible saved checkpoints maximize independent-use validation concept macro; ties choose earliest. If none eligible use terminal for diagnosis and label failed retention.
evaluation_protocol.uncertainty: Report paired per-item transitions and a 95% percentile paired bootstrap over the eight concept clusters, 10000 draws, seed 20261006. This interval is descriptive for the authored corpus and does not estimate training-seed variability.
evaluation_protocol.test_policy: Sealed final-test output cannot select checkpoints or change the protocol. Composition is a separate secondary endpoint.
evaluation_protocol.generation: Greedy, one complete answer per item
evaluation_protocol.claim_limit: Access and use of exposed elementary facts; no new-concept acquisition or undergraduate reliability claim
